description: Seeded HBCU special collections for the HBCU Special Collections Discovery methodology. All URLs are real public portals verified reachable at seed time (2026-07-24); never fabricate URLs. dplaContributorMatch values are provider/contributor display-name matcher fragments for the DPLA hub lane, not URLs.

sources.notes: One of the largest repositories of documentation on the global Black experience; finding aids surface via Digital Howard (dh.howard.edu).

sources.displayName: Fisk University John Hope and Aurelia E. Franklin Library Special Collections
sources.notes: Holdings include the Julius Rosenwald Fund archives and W.E.B. Du Bois materials; Tennessee materials aggregate through DPLA's Tennessee hub.
University archives at Tuskegee University Libraries, including institutional records and the historical lynching documentation tradition begun under Monroe Work.
University archives documenting Hampton Normal and Agricultural Institute's history; museum collections at hamptonu.edu/museum/.

sources.displayName: HBCU Library Alliance Digital Collection (AUC Woodruff Library)
sources.notes: Cross-institution digital collection hosted by the Atlanta University Center Robert W. Woodruff Library; useful fallback lane for member institutions without standalone finding-aid portals (includes Spelman College materials).
